evidence.quote: Some open problems in invariant theory.

Es handelt sich um eine kommentierte Zusammenstellung offener Probleme aus der Theorie der algebraischen Transformationsgruppen und der Invariantentheorie, die bei der Algebra-Tagung in Novosibirsk 1989 aufgeworfen wurden.

trace.notes: Normalized the user input as a zbMATH bibliographic landing page for Popov and Vinberg, 'Some open problems in invariant theory'.

The resolved zbMATH page exposed bibliographic metadata and a short review only; it did not expose the article body or problem statements. Additional exact-title web searches recovered references to the same work but no readable exact-work PDF or HTML full text.
Rejected extraction because the source adequacy gate failed: the available material was resolver metadata/review text rather than the technical source containing the problem statements.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/125230.json and outputs/latest.json.
